reviewer: Codex / GPT-6 Astra, candidate-specific adversarial self-review

reviewScope.binding: Reviews the corrected runtime and tests at sourceCandidateCommit plus the following documentation/workflow/review metadata and formatting-only offline assertion commits. The release runner binds this tracked review checksum to the exact clean final HEAD; no certification success is inferred before that run.
reviewScope.method: Inspect changed execution paths and preserved engine files; falsify owner acceptance claims with focused repository/integration tests, managed production browser paths, keyboard/axe checks, offline image decoding, and actual mobile/desktop screenshot inspection. This is self-review, not an independent human review.
checks: Root redirect is outside Tracker shell; quick/custom/default-restore return to RPG, explicit local deep links preserved, former root Profile available at /profile.
One quest-label helper handles fresh/started/blocked; level arithmetic uses floor and ceiling from unchanged XP engine; reward labels exclude previously earned sources.

Session correction validates references inside coordinated atomic transaction, derives unit, changes attribution and existing reason only; rollback, source-fact preservation, peer-active rejection and single revision tested.
Saved progress correction uses existing validated upsert path; normal forward options remain bounded; accepted/completed rollback and forward replay preserve historical rewards without duplicates.
All 16 known achievement IDs map to distinct decorative local artwork, fallback only unknown/failure; never-visited production offline gallery decoded all images.
Blocked explanation, correction dialog and native Insights summaries preserve keyboard operation; collapsed bodies unmount; Tracker Insights remains unchanged.
390/1280 Hub, Resource, Awards, Insights visually inspected; mobile correction/nav and fresh/started/all-blocked fixtures inspected; 210 lifetime XP displays 110 / 300 to Level 3.
Chromium, Firefox and WebKit changed-route/disclosure spot checks passed without page errors. Focused production keyboard/navigation/axe paths passed.
No changes to domain schemas, DB schema, backup format, XP curve/rules, achievement rules, package/lockfile, catalog or service worker. No new runtime remote resource.

Measured CSS gzip 10112 B requires the authorized 12000 B ceiling. Largest JS raw chunk 368186 B and total JS gzip 285666 B satisfy unchanged ceilings. Final gate will record exact build checksums and counts.

adversarialFindings.description: The RPG save-feedback heading inherited dark text under the default light Tracker theme, reducing contrast against the RPG panel.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Apply the existing RPG text token to the save-result heading; the scoped visual/axe coverage preserves readable feedback without changing theme architecture.

adversarialFindings.description: New recovery/disclosure styling takes CSS gzip slightly beyond the old 10000-byte ceiling.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Use the owner's explicitly permitted 12000-byte hard ceiling, record measured 10112 bytes, preserve both JavaScript limits and enforce them in final certification.

adversarialFindings.description: Browser emulation and automated accessibility cannot establish physical-device ergonomics, human screen-reader usability, hosted-origin headers/update behavior or production rollback.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Accept only for this local candidate. Keep actual iPhone/Android, human screen reader, owner GO, independent remote CI and hosted smoke/rollback as publication prerequisites. No remote publication is authorized by this review.

retrospective.summary: Certification attempts stopped before application tests: first a verified local Vite process held the native Rolldown file during npm ci (process stopped); then the new offline assertion used a DOM type unavailable in the Node E2E project. The assertion now uses a structural image-property type with identical runtime behavior; focused typecheck passes. A subsequent attempt caught missing Prettier wrapping on that repaired assertion; formatting and typecheck were then checked before restart. These attempts are failures, not clean passes. No unresolved P0/P1 was found in the bounded candidate review. Preserve established baseline evidence and run one clean full release gate on the final committed candidate. Focused browser failures were stale six-image/open-timeline assertions, not waived checks; keyboard QA must focus summary rather than its heading. No full ordinary suite was duplicated before certification. Physical/hosted limits remain explicit. A passing gate certifies only its recorded exact HEAD.
